card.summary: 2.5B MMDiT with strong prompt adherence + typography; runs great on ComfyUI (EmptySD3LatentImage, cfg ~4.5).
card.pick_when: Modern general model when typography/prompt-adherence matters.

prompt.example: a photorealistic close-up of an elderly fisherman mending a net at golden hour, 85mm
prompt.overview: MMDiT with a triple text encoder (incl. T5): detailed natural-language prompting, low CFG (~4.5), minimal quality boilerplate.
prompt.instructions: The T5 encoder shifts this from keyword tags to natural language -- write full, specific descriptive sentences ('prompts lacking specificity' increase output uncertainty). Keep T5 tokens under ~256 (edge artifacts appear beyond that; shorten if they show). Defaults: 40 steps, guidance_scale 4.5 (much lower than the SD1/SDXL ~7.5 era). Resolution 0.25-2 MP (target ~1 MP). Consider Skip Layer Guidance for better anatomy. Prefer full natural language over comma-tag stacks; keep negatives minimal or omit them.
dont: Rely on long comma-separated quality-tag boilerplate
examples: A capybara holding a sign that reads Hello World
A whimsical creature that is a hybrid of a waffle and a hippopotamus, basking in a river of melted butter amidst a breakfast-themed landscape, soft morning light, highly detailed, painterly
prompt.negative_guidance: Optional / minimal -- SD3.5 guidance is 'less is better' with negatives (opposite of SD2.x).

speed.measured_note: ~32s for the first image at default settings (1024x1024, 30 steps, cold: includes model load); repeats with the same model are faster.

ui_help.note: Describe what you want in a sentence or two, like you'd tell ChatGPT. More detail usually looks better.
